'''''The Hutt Gambit''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[A. C. Crispin]]. It is the second volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy]]'', following ''[[The Paradise Snare]]'' and preceding ''[[Rebel Dawn]]''. It was first published by [[Bantam Spectra]] on [[August 11]], [[1997]], and the complete trilogy was reprinted in [[The Han Solo Trilogy (hardcover)|''The Han Solo Trilogy'']] ([[1998]]).
